data.name: Subtitle
data.value: A complete TypeScript runtime and compiler built entirely in C#

data.name: Card1_Desc
data.value: Tree-walking execution with instant startup. Perfect for scripting, REPL sessions, and rapid prototyping.

data.name: Card2_Desc
data.value: AOT compilation to standalone .NET assemblies. Ship native binaries with full .NET performance.

data.name: Card3_Desc
data.value: Access .NET BCL types directly via @DotNetType decorators. Bridge TypeScript and C# seamlessly.

data.name: Card4_Desc
data.value: Types, generics, classes, interfaces, modules, decorators, mapped types, conditional types, and more.

data.name: Card5_Desc
data.value: Full async/await support, Promise combinators, generator functions, and async iterators.

data.name: Card6_Desc
data.value: ES6 imports/exports, namespaces, dynamic imports, re-exports, and CommonJS interop.
